title: Ostomy Supply Program Refill Cycle Schedule
content:
The Ostomy Supply Program refill cycle differs by payer tier in five respects: the days of supply in a standard refill, how early Larkfield's refill reminder may be made, how early a refill may ship, whether the customer must confirm each refill, and the consolidation span for a customer's two programs.

## Terms

- **Supply days per shipment** - the standard days of supply in one refill shipment, in calendar days (a multiple of 30).
- **Reminder lead** - the earliest point for Larkfield's refill-reminder contact, in calendar days before the planned ship date.
- **Ship lead** - the earliest point a refill may ship, in calendar days before the end of the supply of the previous refill shipment of the same item.
- **Refill confirmation required** - whether each refill requires the customer's own confirmation of continued use and quantity on hand before it ships; where it is not required, refills ship on subscription schedule.
- **Consolidation span** - refills of a customer's two ostomy programs whose earliest ship dates fall within this many calendar days of each other ship together on the later date.

## Schedule

| Tier | Supply days per shipment | Reminder lead | Ship lead | Refill confirmation required | Consolidation span |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ostomy Self-Pay Program | 30 days | 7 days | 7 days | No (subscription schedule) | 7 days |
| Ostomy Commercial HMO Program | 30 days | 10 days | 7 days | Yes | 10 days |
| Ostomy Commercial PPO Program | 90 days | 10 days | 10 days | Yes | 10 days |
| Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program | 90 days | 14 days | 10 days | Yes | 14 days |
| Ostomy Original Medicare Program | 90 days | 14 days | 10 days | Yes | 14 days |
| Ostomy Medicaid Program | 30 days | 14 days | 7 days | Yes | 14 days |

## Reading the schedule

- Three tiers ship a 90-day standard supply (Commercial PPO, Medicare Advantage, Original Medicare); the Self-Pay, Commercial HMO and Medicaid tiers ship 30 days.
- Only the Ostomy Self-Pay Program ships on subscription schedule without a per-refill confirmation.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* on a tier with a 90-day supply and a 10-day ship lead, a refill whose supply ends on day 90 lets the next refill of the same item ship from day 80.
